(re)boot - Change The Game

### Reduce, reuse, recycle

*   We continue to increase the Recycle and Re-Use Rate in each studio, where the benchmark is at least 50%.
*   The recycling efforts of our Paris studio in one year conserved 17,500 litres of water and 300kg of CO2. Waste recycled in the studio was transformed into 1,050 bottles, 1,011 cardboard boxes and more.
*   Recycling continues to improve throughout our studios. For example, in San Francisco receptacles for recycle and compost are used instead of standard bins. Bespoke signage has been designed with icons that indicate the common items that are acceptable.
*   We are systematically eliminating single-use items such as plastic cups, bottles and utensils in every studio. WPP’s plastic audit ensures actionable solutions are made to tackle pollution from single-use plastics.
*   In San Francisco, all single-use dishware has been eliminated and standard dishwashers have been replaced with industrial machines. Instead of taking one hour and 20 minutes to clean a single load, it now only takes three minutes, while only using two gallons of water instead of ten.
*   Clothes donation programmes are held across studios. In Shanghai, an initiative has been held since 2019 to donate clothing to remote areas. In Paris, over 50kg of clothes have been donated to local associations helping migrants, with employees regularly volunteering at charities to assist.
*   We are ensuring that as little food goes to waste, through initiatives such as the Rescuing Leftover Cuisine programme in New York, where 200kg was donated to the less fortunate – equivalent to 365 meals.
*   In Paris, a studio library and regular flea markets allows for books, clothing and homeware to be shared between each other, giving unwanted items a use.
*   To reduce printing, monthly pay slips are automatically downloaded via an online platform. Electronic food vouchers are also distributed to prevent paper waste.
*   Where possible, old or broken IT hardware are recycled through companies who collect and salvage.
*   Our team in Paris has created the site [SaveGive](https://www.savegive.fr/), a playful experience for those who have kept their current incomes during the Covid-19 pandemic, and are saving money as they are stuck at home. Data determines users’ savings, inviting them to donate a percentage.
*   Ongoing sustainability discussions, events and content continues across studios. For example, digital waste workshops to explain the importance of managing mailbox for productivity and environment impact. Each sent email generates 10g of CO2.

![Reboot-DSC09904](https://images.ctfassets.net/feazk3r7m969/3Z6oSxvZErYiu610MtvWKq/c0af6daac52715a43698ebc985d80ded/Reboot-DSC09904.jpg?w=1920&q=70&fl=progressive)

   OFF\_REBOOT\_CASE\_2M\_16X9\_20230602-3 from AKQA on Vimeo

(re)boot – Change The Game

### Sustainable supplies

*   We take the necessary steps to ensure that our suppliers, contractors and partners employ best practice in sustainability, from reduced-plastic sanitary products to neutral, organic, biodegradable, chemical-free tea bags and bamboo tableware.
*   In Atlanta, this includes the provision of plant-derived cleaning supplies, made from renewable natural resources which do not contain chemicals such as chlorine bleach, ammonia, paragons or phosphates.

### Human powered

*   We are finding more sustainable ways to travel, from reducing the number of flights we take, to encouraging the use of two wheels over four with Cycle to Work schemes. In Amsterdam, 90% of our employees commute to work by bicycle.
*   This includes our suppliers, where in Amsterdam and Paris, all of the studio’s environmentally friendly cultivated fruit and flower deliveries are brought by bicycle.

### Greener spaces

*   Our motivation for a more sustainable environment extends to the physical spaces and structures in which we work.
*   New technologies and an awareness for conservation of natural resources permeate AKQA Casa, our studio in São Paulo. The roof uses thermo-acoustical tiles to control insulation, while reclaimed materials and the introduction of sustainable systems such as solar panels, rainwater collection and LED lighting minimise the consumption of natural resources such as electric energy and treated water.

  ![BBC-01-a-large](https://images.ctfassets.net/feazk3r7m969/0GEqZmJyRqGwE72XzBkwD/3e41dcb5729013d07eaf193759867e7f/article-01-a-large.jpg?w=1920&q=70&fl=progressive)

BBC Worldwide – Story of Life

  ![BBC Earth and AKQA launch Story of Life main-large-7](https://images.ctfassets.net/feazk3r7m969/7dGQxGgvsWWwRJNQ7omfBC/bcdcaeec18d77b2dc4348b951e4121ac/main-large-7.jpg?w=1920&q=70&fl=progressive)

#### Taking it further

The actions and initiatives that will help inspire us to make further progress include:

### Environmentally friendly office practices

*   We continue to encourage behaviours from our employees that facilitate a reduction in environmental impact – from simple reminders on conserving energy such as switching off lights, to educational talks and training on sustainability best practices.
*   We are working with our landlords in each studio to promote more environmentally sustainable conditions. Ultimately, the goal is for each studio to be located in a building with comprehensive green credentials (for example, LEED certification).

### Water conservation practices

*   Reducing consumption of natural resources has the biggest impact than any other sustainability initiative. The implementation of low-flow faucets, taps, toilets, urinals and shower heads will be a large step towards achieving our reduced consumption goals.

### Low-impact renewable energy use

*   We are working to increase our percentage of energy-use produced from low-impact renewable sources. This includes solar panel phone charging stations and rechargeable batteries.

### Environmental design practices

*   We are committed to carrying out recycling and reclamation programmes to support the proper disposal or re-use of products, including furniture and electronics.

### Modern Slavery Act statement

*   AKQA does not tolerate any form of modern slavery or human trafficking in any part of our business. AKQA is a subsidiary of WPP, therefore please refer to WPP’s Modern Slavery statement [here](https://www.akqa.com/modern-slavery-statement-2023/).

### AKQA supply chain

*   Wherever possible, AKQA uses suppliers who are appointed by WPP Group Procurement teams for commonly purchased goods and services. These suppliers are selected in accordance with the WPP Procurement Policy. If AKQA needs to use a supplier outside the approved supplier list, then it is the responsibility of AKQA to select suppliers in accordance with the process and due diligence requirements outlined in the WPP Procurement Policy.

![UFS-thumb](https://images.ctfassets.net/feazk3r7m969/5EewuxtLJwGgodY1nj1YgZ/f88830389398b4092370236504223765/UFS-thumb.png?w=1920)

   UFS\_60sec from AKQA on Vimeo

Vivaldi – The \[uncertain\] Four Seasons

### Clients

We are committed to working with clients that share values towards people and planet, and in ambition to build a better future.

#### Impact

*   78% of WPP’s top 50 clients have set science-based targets. We work closely with the rest of our client roster to help them define and realise their own sustainability commitments.
*   We use the WPP Green Claims Guide to help our teams ensure that any environmental claims made on behalf of clients are fair and accurate, and to avoid content that could be misleading in any way.
*   We help clients realise their sustainability and social impact goals, with examples of our work including [(re)boot](https://www.akqa.com/work/reboot/change-the-game), [Follow the Flowers](https://www.akqa.com/work/follow-the-flowers/this-honey-heals-country/), [Buy Better Wear Longer](https://www.akqa.com/work/levis/buy-better-wear-longer/) and [Transparency Card](https://www.akqa.com/work/congresso-em-foco/transparency-card/).

![Transparancey card-thumb](https://images.ctfassets.net/feazk3r7m969/4ONytZQAcTNeG8SFakC9zl/6441ce20c7c256067e78a346ea0ac889/Transparancey_card-thumb.jpg?w=1920&q=70&fl=progressive)

   Transparency card from AKQA on Vimeo

Congresso em Foco – Transparency Card

We are committed to shining a light on important issues and lifting up others as we grow. This way, we can build equitable futures for people across society. To do this, we support and engage with the communities we work within, striving to give access to new opportunities and sharing our expertise.

#### Impact

*   We launched the educational platform [SOMA+](https://www.somosoma.com/) to expand the professional knowledge of Black, indigenous and low-income students taking undergraduate communication courses in Brazil.
*   We support charities and organisations through our pro bono work. These clients include Lewis Hamilton’s [Mission 44](https://mission44.org/) in London, the [Duke of Ellington School of the Arts](https://www.ellingtonschool.org/) in Washington DC, [LYRIC](https://lyric.org/) in San Francisco and [A Plastic Planet](https://www.madethought.com/work/a-plastic-planet) by Made Thought, among others.
*   We launched [Future Lions](https://www.futurelions.com/#/) and the Future Academy to give a platform and a voice to the next generation of creative innovators which has, in turn, helped to discover and foster innumerable talents. Hundreds of alumni have gone on to join top creative and design agencies.

Date last updated January 2025.
Responsible disclosure policy
AKQA (“we”, “us”, “our”) appreciates and values the identification and reporting of security vulnerabilities carried out by well-intentioned, ethical security researchers (“you”). This vulnerability disclosure policy applies to any vulnerabilities you are considering reporting to us. We recommend reading this vulnerability disclosure policy fully before you report a vulnerability and always acting in compliance with it.
We do not offer a bug bounty program or monetary rewards for responsible disclosures and compensation requests will not be considered in compliance with this responsible disclosure policy.
Reporting
If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please submit your report to us using the following email address: yourdata@akqa.com.
Your report should include details of:
The website, domain, IP or page where the vulnerability can be observed.
Steps to reproduce which should be a benign, non-destructive, proof of concept. This helps to ensure that the report can be triaged quickly and accurately.
If you have any concerns or queries with regard reporting, please email yourdata@akqa.com for advice.
What to expect
We aim to confirm receipt of your vulnerability report within 5 working days and triage your report within 10 working days. We also aim to keep you informed of our progress and completion of any remediation activities. We may contact you if we require further information regarding your report.
Remediation of any reported vulnerabilities are assessed based upon their impact, severity and exploit complexity. Vulnerability reports might take some time to triage or address. You are welcome to enquire on the status but we ask that you avoid doing so more than once every 14 days to allow our teams to focus on the remediation.
Guidance
You must NOT:
Break any applicable law or regulations.
Access unnecessary, excessive or significant amounts of data or modify data in our systems or services.
Disrupt our services or systems, use high-intensity invasive or destructive scanning tools to find vulnerabilities or attempt any form of denial of service.
Submit reports detailing non-exploitable vulnerabilities, or reports indicating that the services do not fully align with “best practice”, for example missing security headers.
Submit reports detailing TLS configuration weaknesses, for example “weak” cipher suite support or the presence of TLS1.0 support.
Social engineer, ‘phish’ or physically attack our staff or infrastructure.
Demand financial compensation in order to disclose any vulnerabilities.
You must:
Always comply with data protection rules and must not violate the privacy of our users, staff, contractors, services or systems. You must not, for example, share, redistribute or fail to properly secure data retrieved from the systems or services.
Securely delete all data retrieved during your research as soon as it is no longer required or within 1 month of the vulnerability being resolved, whichever occurs first (or as otherwise required by data protection law).
Legalities
This policy is designed to be compatible with common vulnerability disclosure good practice. It does not give you permission to act in any manner that is inconsistent with the law, or which might cause us to be in breach of any legal obligations.

# WPP responsible disclosures policy template

### Date last updated January 2025.

### Responsible disclosure policy

AKQA (“we”, “us”, “our”) appreciates and values the identification and reporting of security vulnerabilities carried out by well-intentioned, ethical security researchers (“you”). This vulnerability disclosure policy applies to any vulnerabilities you are considering reporting to us. We recommend reading this vulnerability disclosure policy fully before you report a vulnerability and always acting in compliance with it.

We do not offer a bug bounty program or monetary rewards for responsible disclosures and compensation requests will not be considered in compliance with this responsible disclosure policy.

### Reporting

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please submit your report to us using the following email address: [yourdata@akqa.com](mailto:yourdata@akqa.com).

Your report should include details of:

*   The website, domain, IP or page where the vulnerability can be observed.
*   Steps to reproduce which should be a benign, non-destructive, proof of concept. This helps to ensure that the report can be triaged quickly and accurately.

If you have any concerns or queries with regard reporting, please email [yourdata@akqa.com](mailto:yourdata@akqa.com) for advice.

### What to expect

We aim to confirm receipt of your vulnerability report within 5 working days and triage your report within 10 working days. We also aim to keep you informed of our progress and completion of any remediation activities. We may contact you if we require further information regarding your report.

Remediation of any reported vulnerabilities are assessed based upon their impact, severity and exploit complexity. Vulnerability reports might take some time to triage or address. You are welcome to enquire on the status but we ask that you avoid doing so more than once every 14 days to allow our teams to focus on the remediation.

### Guidance

You must NOT:

*   Break any applicable law or regulations.
*   Access unnecessary, excessive or significant amounts of data or modify data in our systems or services.
*   Disrupt our services or systems, use high-intensity invasive or destructive scanning tools to find vulnerabilities or attempt any form of denial of service.
*   Submit reports detailing non-exploitable vulnerabilities, or reports indicating that the services do not fully align with “best practice”, for example missing security headers.
*   Submit reports detailing TLS configuration weaknesses, for example “weak” cipher suite support or the presence of TLS1.0 support.
*   Social engineer, ‘phish’ or physically attack our staff or infrastructure.
*   Demand financial compensation in order to disclose any vulnerabilities.

You must:

*   Always comply with data protection rules and must not violate the privacy of our users, staff, contractors, services or systems. You must not, for example, share, redistribute or fail to properly secure data retrieved from the systems or services.
*   Securely delete all data retrieved during your research as soon as it is no longer required or within 1 month of the vulnerability being resolved, whichever occurs first (or as otherwise required by data protection law).

### Legalities

This policy is designed to be compatible with common vulnerability disclosure good practice. It does not give you permission to act in any manner that is inconsistent with the law, or which might cause us to be in breach of any legal obligations.

jsonLd.title: Freelance Designer (Future Opportunity)
jsonLd.description: <p>We are proactively seeking exceptional design talent for potential future opportunities with AKQA. This is not a current open position, but rather a talent identification effort for an upcoming 3-month project, with the possibility of extension.</p>\n<p>At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products, and services. # Creative Director (Design) - San Francisco

#### San Francisco, United States

At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.

Creatives at AKQA apply artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight to create and bring to life beautiful ideas that move the world. Skilled storytellers and conceptors, they work in a multidisciplinary environment to develop labors of love that delight customers and deliver results for clients.

Creative Directors play essential roles in the strategy, conception and design of beautiful ideas, products and services. They bring exceptional creative thought and craft output, developing and delivering projects from brief to end user.

Creative Directors at AKQA approach every brief with fresh eyes. Avoiding familiar solutions, the Creative Director generates useful, usable ideas across all existing and emerging platforms. Creative Directors create and inspire work that is distinctive, effective and truly remarkable.

AKQA offers our staff the opportunity to produce meaningful work for world-class companies in one of the world’s most vibrant and beautiful cities.

**Responsibilities**

*   **Direct**. Directs the effort to develop creative concepts and implementations in a cross-disciplinary manner. Works with planners and strategists to establish strategic and creative approaches for a given assignment.
*   **Creative craft skills**. Sets creative direction and strategic guidance throughout the duration of client team projects. Displays a cohesive understanding, and ability to execute.
*   **Concepting**.  Leads, develops, and inspires the team to innovate thinking and solutions through strong process and methodology.
*   **Presenting**. Construct and craft a compelling narrative to effectively communicate creative work both internally tp the team and externally to client.
*   **Leadership**. Sets the Tone on professional standards for the team and the department. Inspires and leads by example, evangelizes and represents AKQA externally through various leadership opportunities, conferences, speaking and writing engagements. Leads and manages 30+ creatives on an on-going basis.
*   **Mentoring**. Acts as a Career Manager, guiding creatives of all levels within AKQA, including regular one-on-one check-in’s, writing and delivering annual performance reviews and takes responsibility for on-boarding new employees and guiding him/her through a successful tenure at AKQA.
*   **Relationship**. Works in conjunction with the Client Services team to actively build a strong relationship with a given client. Contributes significantly in growing breadth of business with existing clients.
*   **New business development**. Creatively leads new business pitches. Is responsible for the ideas and the creative work, and articulating a compelling story. 

**Role Requirements**

*   An excellent portfolio
*   A minimum of 12 years’ experience in the creative industry
*   Proven track record supporting clients in the premium consumer technology and electronics category
*   Strong track record for managing $10 – 20MM of business per year
*   Exceptional communication skills: verbal, written, interpersonal and inter-departmental
*   Thoughtful leadership; a strong point of view; ability to contribute to strategic development
*   Strong ability and experience in leading, directing and managing a group of cross-disciplinary teams
*   Detail oriented and has the ability to multi-task across multiple workstreams
*   Dynamic Presenter
*   Understanding of digital media as well as the marketing industry at large; an ability and a desire to adapt to the changing landscape of technology
*   Act as a creative partner for other cross-department relationships such as with Strategy and client services. Ability to establish and maintain strong, dynamic client relationships
*   Track record of winning pitches and awards

**Qualities and Characteristics**

*   You have an award-winning portfolio of digital work that demonstrates high quality art direction, storytelling and a clean, contemporary design aesthetic within a variety of campaigns and projects for website launches, site redesigns, email marketing, mobile experiences, and digital product launches
*   You have a breadth of cultural reference points
*   You have a drive to break boundaries and craft the best ideas in the world of their kind
*   You are fearless, boundlessly creative and relentlessly attentive to detail

Preference given to candidates located in or willing to relocate to the SF Bay Area; all candidates must be able to work West Coast hours.

Senior Editor - London - AKQA
London, United Kingdom 
At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and experiences that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.
The Senior Editor will play a crucial role in crafting the narrative and visual storytelling of our projects. They will collaborate closely with the creative team and Creative Director to ensure that all footage is edited to perfection, aligning with the creative vision and project goals.
The role requires a strong sense of pacing, rhythm, and a mastery of the latest editing software and techniques. The Senior Editor will be key in integrating new technologies and workflows, such as virtual production and real-time editing, to deliver sealess, high-quality content.
ROLE REQUIREMENTS
Perform editing tasks, including assembling, cutting, refining, and finalising footage to achieve the desired narrative and visual flow.
Assist in assembling and organising raw footage, assets, and materials in preparation for editing.
Manage and maintain an organised project file structure and ensure all assets are correctly labelled and accessible.
Implement any changes or adjustments quickly and efficiently in response to client feedback or creative direction.
Ensure all edits are completed on time and within scope, maintaining high standards of quality and consistency.
Utilise SFX skills to enhance visual storytelling, adding sound effects, transitions, and other audio elements to elevate the overall impact of the project.
Prepare and ensure the delivery of offline edits, confirming all files are correctly formatted and fully usable for VFX or third-party partners.
Participate in initial planning meetings with the creative team and Creative Director to establish editing strategies and timelines.
Review project briefs and creative direction to fully understand the editing requirements and objectives.
Develop an initial editing workflow and schedule, ensuring alignment with project deadlines and deliverables.
Collaborate with other departments to optimise post-production processes on other projects.
Evaluate and recommend editing tools, software, and technologies needed for the specific project.
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging editing technologies, recommending and implementing new tools and techniques.
QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS
5+ years of experience in video editing.
Expertise in editing software and post-production processes, including virtual and real-time production.
Ensures seamless offline delivery with properly formatted files for VFX and third-party partners.
Proficient in industry-standard editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Avid Media Composer).
Skilled in organising and managing multiple projects while maintaining high-quality standards.
Excellent aesthetic judgment aligned with the AKQA vision.
Strong creativity as well as strong ideation and conception skills.
Strong technical creativity: being able to combine novel, experimental technologies to create cutting edge visuals.
Strong understanding of post-production workflows, including colour grading, sound design, and VFX integration.
Proficient in managing and organising large volumes of media and project files.
Experience with SFX and audio editing tools to enhance visual storytelling.
Familiarity with virtual production, real-time editing technologies, and cloud-based collaboration tools.
Knowledge of various video formats, codecs, and file types for optimal delivery across platforms.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and ensure smooth operation of editing systems and equipment.

Senior Strategist - Amsterdam - AKQA
Amsterdam, Netherlands 
At AKQA we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful and performative ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we craft powerful storytelling, design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering meaningful returns for our clients.
As a strategist at AKQA, you work to shape an organisation's identity, positioning, communications, and growth trajectory. Actively seeking to bring consumer voice into the work, you help companies of all scales relate to their intended audience, differentiate from the category, and take the lead in the culture. You work collaboratively with the rest of the studio to grow brands creatively and effectively, through the lens of expression, experience, and business.
As a Senior Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of client projects, uncovering actionable insights, and delivering innovative solutions that drive growth. You will lead Brand and Communication Strategy initiatives, expand our strategy toolkit, and define KPIs to measure project success. This role also involves building strong relationships with clients and vendors, identifying new opportunities, and leading the pitching process. Staying ahead of industry trends, you will proactively identify growth opportunities for the studio and contribute thought-leadership outputs that inspire both clients and colleagues.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Analyze RFPs and client briefs to identify opportunities and challenges, crafting clear strategic approaches that outline project scope, deliverables, timelines, and resource allocation.
Develop compelling reverse briefs that reframe client problems, propose innovative solutions, and address potential roadblocks to ensure alignment and impactful outcomes.
Lead all aspects of research—from ideation and planning to execution, analysis, and delivery—to uncover actionable insights that fuel client growth and inform new studio offerings.
Transform research findings into compelling reports and presentations, delivering clear, strategic recommendations that empower clients to make informed decisions and capitalize on opportunities.
Define and deliver core strategic outputs for brand (e.g., architecture, values, personality) and communication (e.g., creative briefs, messaging hierarchies, communication plans) projects.
Continuously refine and expand the studio's strategy toolkit by incorporating new frameworks, deliverables, and best practices to address evolving client needs and marketing trends.
Establish KPIs, success metrics, and measurement frameworks to track project effectiveness, demonstrate value to clients, and optimize strategies over time.
Cultivate collaborative partnerships with internal teams, external vendors, and clients, acting as a trusted advisor to identify opportunities and deliver creative solutions.
Standardize the studio’s deliverables into reusable templates and frameworks, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and knowledge sharing across the team.
Stay updated on cultural, marketing, creative, and technological trends relevant to clients and the industry, identifying opportunities where the studio can add more value.
Lead the pitching process, from analyzing RFPs and developing strategic perspectives to briefing creatives and presenting work to clients.
QUALIFICATIONS:
7+ years of experience in roles spanning brand consultancy, marketing strategy, integrated communication strategy, channel planning, and content excellence.
An insatiable curiosity with the ability to observe and identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights.
A lateral and creative thinker capable of simplifying complex topics into clear, actionable ideas.
Strong understanding of funnel marketing and the ability to drive solutions across all stages.
Able to see the big picture while maintaining sharp attention to detail, consistently striving for best-in-class work.
Deep understanding of how businesses, brands, and consumers interact, and how technology shapes their behaviors and decisions.
Skilled at identifying the core potential of an idea and experienced in evaluating its quality and impact.
Broad sector expertise with experience across two or more industries and multi-channel media strategies.
Proficient in collaborating with the Strategy Director for guidance, approvals, and escalation of concerns throughout project lifecycles.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage and influence senior clients, including Heads, Directors, VPs, and C-Suite executives.

# Client Partner - Amsterdam - AKQA

#### Amsterdam, Netherlands

At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.

The Client Services team are entrepreneurs who champion clients and colleagues alike. With a keen sense for turning insight into opportunity, they are responsible for building relationships that foster commercial viability for our studio and our clients business.

A Client Partner is a leadership position that requires expertise in transformational programs of work that deliver positive outcomes through products and service ecosystems, differentiated business models and the brand experience surrounding them. 

You will lead a multidisciplinary team in the endless pursuit of growing our remit with existing partners and converting new growth opportunities. Reporting to the Client Services Director you will partner with leads and management to create a work environment that fosters collaboration and innovation. 

Located on the Herengracht canal in central Amsterdam, you will have access to our diverse network of specialists by collaborating across our twelve European studios. You will work in an environment which fosters a meritocratic culture and encourages ownership, and you will be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in their fields. 

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

*   Identify, engage, convert and scale new opportunities into long-term client relationships
*   Lead regional pitch responses and procurement processes
*   Develop relationships with prospective clients, while maintaining existing client relationships
*   Partner with discipline leads to create contract-winning proposals for current and prospective clients
*   Understand the language of business to grow our CX, Venture and Product revenue targets
*   Become a subject matter expert on topics that drive our clients business
*   Maintain a strong understanding of products and services, and innovating new ways to serve businesses
*   Uncover, analyse, and anticipate appropriate payment models and pricing structures for target customers who represent early-stage businesses to enterprise scale-ups
*   Work tightly with a multidisciplinary team to design a new venture that creates new sources of revenue for our business
*   Craft and foster Quarterly and Annual Business reviews for existing clients to provide visibility of major client initiatives over next 12 months
*   Organise team resource and configuration and sets out detailed month by month forecasts against which resources can be planned

QUALITY AND CHARACTERISTICS

*   10+ years working in a client services or account management role in a creative environment.
*   Prior success in business development and building and maintain client relationships
*   Understanding of a strategic consulting and professional services approach
*   Experience of managing global clients and leading accounts at a senior level
*   Comfort and experience in building and leading world-class teams
*   Demonstrates an in-depth understanding of wider commercial issues
*   Experience of inspiring and managing teams
*   Highly competent and confident presenter in Keynote 
*   Possesses a strong quality of leadership, in both the work and in decision-making 
*   High emotional intellect, the ability to drive projects and lead an internal team through various scenarios with clients 
*   Operational savvy and know-how, in order to work with the teams and draw the balance between servicing our clients and protecting our own team and interests

Explore our extensive range of benefits [**here**](https://www.akqa.com/studios/amsterdam/benefits).

Paris, France 
At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering immersive experiences for our clients.
We are looking for an established practitioner of the latest web technologies; building best in class applications, serving users on the modern web landscape, whatever that may be. 
Collaborating in a team of highly skilled people, each with strong opinions about various technologies, frameworks and approaches to delivery; you will need to communicate your ideas to your colleagues effectively, and articulate them to other internal stakeholders.

You will join a close-knit and high-skilled team and gain hands-on experience as you design, code, test, launch and sustain digital solutions that enable satisfying and seamless experiences for people out there.

Contribute hands-on with the development of a range of solutions including websites, web apps, CI pipelines, and headless CMS integrations.
Define and implement scalable, maintainable front-end architectures using modern frameworks.
Work closely with other departments to ensure alignment across disciplines and to resolve day-to-day technical challenges.
Collaborate closely with UX, design and creative teams to deliver pixel-perfect interfaces with exceptional animation, motion and rendering performance.
Champion modern front-end tooling to improve velocity, code quality and team workflow.

Participate in pitches.

Stay ahead of emerging technologies and propose ways to integrate innovation meaningfully, especially around AI.

6+ years of experience in front-end development, including large or complex code bases.
Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React.js and/or Vue.js.
Deep understanding of SPA / SSR / Jamstack / ISR paradigms.
Mastery of advanced animation techniques (CSS, SVG, GSAP, Framer Motion, canvas…).
Committed to performance, code quality, good practice and delivering high end products.
Proficient with the GIT and its related tooling (branching flow, CLI commands etc.).
Interest in mentoring of the developers (presentations, code-review, pair-programming etc.).
Experience working with headless CMS, GraphQL, APIs and modern CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of design tools such as Sketch or Figma.
Familiarity with Agile and Lean methodologies.
Exceptional organisational skills and methodical approach.
Comfortable with the trade-offs of using different engineering solutions to a problem, favouring pragmatism over idealism.
You have a collaborative spirit and you make a point of listening to different perspectives with an open-minded approach.
Eager to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Boundlessly creative and relentlessly attentive to detail.
You demonstrate awareness and care about analytics and KPIs to improve the interface performance and a high level of accountability through the whole project lifecycle. 
You will also contribute to the continuous evolution of our front-end stack, shared components, and internal best practices; helping shape the engineering culture of our studio.
AI & Emerging Tech Fluency:
Strong interest and fluency in building AI-enhanced front-end experiences.
Hands-on experience integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, …)
Understanding of AI orchestration tools and principles, such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Comfortable exploring how AI-first UX can shape new interfaces and product interactions.
Nice to have:
Experience with shadcn/ui, Radix UI and other modern component systems for React.
Knowledge of 3D front-end development (Three.js, WebGL, shaders…).
Experience building and documenting design systems with Storybook.
Familiarity with Cloud-native environments (AWS, Vercel, Azure).

#### Paris, France

At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products, and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design digital experiences that capture the imagination and deliver impressive results for our clients.

Creatives at AKQA are both visionaries and makers. They bring powerful ideas to life—ideas that are grounded in strategy and executed with craftsmanship and care. As an Art Director, you play a critical role in shaping visual narratives and elevating brands through conceptually strong and beautifully executed work.

At AKQA Paris, you’ll craft compelling visuals that resonate with diverse audiences, leading creative sessions and ensuring high standards from concept to production. You’ll guide emerging team members, collaborate across teams, and maintain brand-aligned style guides, consistently gathering inspiring imagery to elevate client work.

This is a chance to work in a vibrant, multicultural studio on forward-thinking creative projects for iconic brands, alongside a team that values curiosity, innovation, and excellence.

### **ROLE REQUIREMENTS**

*   Lead and contribute to the development of original, compelling visual concepts across campaigns, content, and digital experiences.
*   Craft visual approaches tailored to a diverse range of clients and audiences, always grounded in strategic insight.
*   Collaborate with copywriters and multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated ideas that align with client goals and brand values.
*   Champion creative quality throughout the process—from concept to final production—ensuring consistency, craft, and attention to detail at every touchpoint.
*   Present work with confidence and clarity to internal teams and clients, clearly articulating the rationale behind creative decisions.
*   Develop and maintain visual style guides that reflect brand identity and enable creative exploration.
*   Stay attuned to cultural trends, breakthrough design work, and innovation across industries—regularly gathering and sharing references that elevate the work.
*   Lead creative workshops and provide mentorship to emerging designers, fostering a culture of growth and creative excellence.
*   Collaborate with teams across strategy, experience design, and client services to ensure alignment and consistency throughout each project.
*   Ensure efficient workflows across pre-production, production, and post-production phases.
*   Contribute to internal showcases and case studies that highlight the impact and effectiveness of your work.

### **QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS**

*   A compelling portfolio that demonstrates exceptional art direction, conceptual thinking, and craft across various platforms and formats.
